name: gbr
description: Pair a phone running Build Remote Agent to a local Codex session. Phone is spectator plus veto. Attach only via 127.0.0.1:8788 or gbr-mcp after gbr-agent run.

interface.shortDescription: Phone spectator for a local Codex session
interface.longDescription: Pair the Build Remote Agent phone app to this desktop Codex session through free MIT gbr-agent. Scan the QR or type the 8-char code, keep gbr-agent run, then attach at 127.0.0.1:8788 or gbr-mcp. The phone spectates and can veto; it does not orchestrate. Independent product. Not affiliated with xAI or SpaceX.
